contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-payment-records-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-payment-records-api-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-records.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-records`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7 guide at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-records maintains an on-/off-Stripe payment history with one PaymentRecord, multiple PaymentAttemptRecords and append-only entries. With Orchestration enabled Stripe automatically records on-Stripe PaymentIntents, and merchants can report external payments, failed attempts, retries and completed refunds (new raw lines 17-41 and 135-187). Entries remain preview-only. For Checkout with Stripe’s custom PayPal adapter, abandonment before PayPal or expiration produces canceled, with an open Session waiting for expiry. Return from PayPal without approving produces failed with payment_method_customer_decline; PayPal decline produces failed with payment_method_provider_decline (new raw lines 251-263). April described preview entries and webhook/listing but no adapter-specific classification (old raw lines 216-228). source-stripe-payment-records.md preserves the hierarchy and reporting methods but overstates the Orchestration condition and needs the adapter-specific events and refund-reporting distinction.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-records, the substantive November addition is the preview-scoped custom PayPal Checkout distinction between abandonment and customer or provider decline, using entries associated through the Session payment_record (new raw lines 251-263; old raw lines 216-228). The ASCII attempt diagram, curl translations, revised report link and JSON punctuation are illustrative or presentational. Preserve in source-stripe-payment-records.md the dated April hierarchy and Orchestration-scoped automation (old raw lines 16-46; new raw lines 17-43), the preview qualification and historical identifier routes. Keep recording a processor refund distinct from making one (old raw lines 113-143; new raw lines 172-187). Preserve the existing reconciliation route, add a reciprocal Stripe Orchestration concept route, and keep the companion custom-adapter guide and native Stripe PayPal separate.
